Class JobAnimation

java.lang.Object
common.animation.JobAnimation
All Implemented Interfaces:
Animation
public class JobAnimation extends Object implements Animation
Created by IntelliJ IDEA. User: orsotronIII Date: 17-gen-2005 Time: 13.53.44 Represents a job to be routed through the queue net. Paths to be followed must be specified. If more than one path is defined, this class randomly decides which path to follow next when the current one is completed.

      timer that keeps trace of the millisecs passed by the time this job entered the element (e.g. edge or station) it is going through

  • Constructor Details

    • JobAnimation

      public JobAnimation(double speed, JobPath[] jps, Rectangle bounds)
      Creates a new instance of JobAnimation initialized with specified default paths to be followed by the job and specified speed.
      Parameters:
      speed - : speed this job must keep following its paths. It is measured in pixels per second
      jps - : paths this Job can go through
      bounds - : default size for this job

    • JobAnimation

      public JobAnimation(JobAnimation job)
      Creates a new instance of JobAnimation initialized with specified values of another job.
      Parameters:
      job - : job wanted to be copied.

    • JobAnimation

      public JobAnimation(double speed, JobPath[] jps, Rectangle bounds, IconsToolkit toolkit)
      Creates a new instance of JobAnimation initialized with specified default paths to be followed by the job and specified speed.
      Parameters:
      speed - : speed this job must keep following its paths. It is measured in pixels per second
      jps - : paths this Job can go through
      bounds - : default size for this job
      toolkit - : Image toolkit for customized renderization of job image

    • resetTimeOfEntrance

      public void resetTimeOfEntrance()
      Resets the time of entrance of this job in the element that currently contains it. every class that accepts jobs must call this method whenever a a new job is added, in order to calculate the correct position once the job speed is known.
